shots.prompt: Victorian London 1890s. The tall schoolroom door swings open; the headmistress and the thin solicitor with a document case step in with grave faces; the birthday party falls silent. Nobody speaks.
The Japanese woman in a black dress buttons her thin black cardigan in front of the mirror, takes a deep breath and straightens her back, then turns toward the door. Nobody speaks.

At the back of the Japanese classroom, the woman standing alone looks toward the other mothers; their eyes meet for a moment, then they turn away one by one. She keeps standing straight. Nobody speaks.
The Japanese woman looks at her phone for a moment, then slowly puts it face down on the kitchen table and lets out a quiet sigh. Nobody speaks.
In the dark living room the smartphone on the low table lights up and vibrates; the Japanese woman slowly reaches for it. Nobody speaks.

Victorian London 1890s. Close-up of the 11-year-old girl with short jet-black hair in the pink party frock, thoughtful and calm, answers quietly in Japanese: 「できると思うわ。簡単ではないでしょうけど」 Only this one person speaks.
